timeline_disposition.reason: Tsongkhapa (1357–1419) is a securely historical Tibetan religious philosopher whose mature intellectual and institutional career unfolded across multiple Central Tibetan monasteries and teaching networks before the foundation of Ganden. The reviewed evidence establishes his life and philosophical importance but does not require a single exact canonical polity interval for that intellectual activity. ATLAS therefore retains the historical Person without manufacturing a polity-bound Activity rail.

sources.title: Tsongkhapa — Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.citation_text: SEP identifies Tsongkhapa Losang Drakpa (1357–1419) as a major Tibetan religious philosopher and one of the most influential and innovative scholars and practitioners in Tibetan Buddhist history.

sources.title: Tsongkhapa — The Treasury of Lives
sources.citation_text: The Treasury of Lives records Tsongkhapa, 1357–1419, as a historical Geluk/Kadam master and the first Ganden Tripa, with extensive study and teaching across Tibetan traditions.
